description: This file defines a Java interface 'CodeValueMapper' that uses MapStruct to map between 'CodeValue' domain objects and 'CodeValueData' data transfer objects. It provides methods for single object and list mappings, configured with a specific MapStruct configuration.

classes.name: CodeValueMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting between CodeValue domain objects and CodeValueData DTOs.

methods.name: map(CodeValue)
methods.description: Maps a CodeValue domain object to a CodeValueData DTO, with a property 'label' mapped to 'name'.

methods.name: map(List<CodeValue>)
methods.description: Maps a list of CodeValue domain objects to a list of CodeValueData DTOs.
